    Description

    Close your eyes. Now imagine a garden following you everywhere you go.

    Garden of Eden is a natural solid deodorant with a subtle, fresh frangipani fragrance — feminine without trying too hard. Made with magnesium hydroxide to neutralise odour at source and arrowroot powder to keep underarms dry, this is aluminium-free, baking soda-free, chemical-free personal care that genuinely works.

    No pore-blocking compounds. No synthetic chemicals. No irritation. Just plant-based odour control that lets your skin breathe naturally all day.

    Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin. Comes with a reusable wooden spatula in a recyclable tin.

    15g. Made in India.

    Natural colour and scent may vary slightly across batches — this is a feature, not a flaw. Always patch test before use

    Shelf life: Use within 24 months of manufacture. Store in a cool, dry place

    Read more about our natural, eco-friendly deodorants here

    Note: While our deodorant effectively absorbs some moisture, it is not an antiperspirant

    --------------

    MRP: Rs.289/- incl. of all taxes (per unit)

    Caution: For external use only

    Country of Origin: India

    --------------

    How to use

    Using the wooden spatula, scoop a small amount and apply directly onto clean, dry underarms. Gently massage into the skin until fully absorbed. Close the tin after use and store in a cool, dry place. Wash and dry the spatula periodically to keep it fresh.
    Ingredients

    Maranta Arundinacea (Arrowroot) Root Extract, Cocos nucifera (Coconut) oil Theobroma Cacao Seed Butter, Glycine Soja (Soy) Wax, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Wax, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Magnesium hydroxide, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Vitamin E (Natural), Plumeria alba (Frangipani) essential oil
    What to expect

    A garden that follows you — subtle frangipani fragrance that's present but never overpowering, natural and just right

    Odour neutralised at source — magnesium hydroxide creates an alkaline environment that targets odour-causing bacteria rather than masking smell

    Stays dry and comfortable — arrowroot powder absorbs excess moisture without blocking pores or disrupting natural perspiration

    Skin that feels nourished — coconut oil, cacao seed butter, apricot and sweet almond oils hydrate and soften underarm skin with every use

    No white cast or stains — massages in cleanly, nothing left on clothing

    Breathable all day — aluminium-free formula lets your skin perspire naturally for 8-10 hours

    Frequently Asked Questions

    • HOW IT WORKS
    • IS IT RIGHT FOR ME
    • THE BARE BASICS
    Is this an antiperspirant?

    No - and that's intentional. This is a natural deodorant that controls odour and absorbs moisture while letting your skin breathe and perspire naturally. No pore-blocking here.

    Does it actually stop odour all day?

    Yes! Magnesium hydroxide neutralises odour-causing bacteria by creating an alkaline environment on your skin. Combined with arrowroot powder absorbing moisture, you stay fresh for 8-10 hours through your daily routine.

    Why no aluminium or baking soda?

    Aluminium blocks sweat glands - we'd rather let your body do its thing. And baking soda, while effective, can irritate sensitive skin. We use magnesium hydroxide instead - equally effective, far gentler.

    Will it leave marks on my clothes?

    No. Apply a small amount, massage in fully, and you're good. No white cast, no staining.

    How do I apply it correctly?

    Use the wooden spatula to scoop a small amount and apply directly onto clean, dry underarms. Massage gently until absorbed. That's it.

    Is this safe for sensitive skin?

    Yes. The formula is aluminium-free, baking soda-free, and uses hypoallergenic IFRA-certified fragrances. We always recommend a patch test first if your skin is particularly reactive.

    Can I use this right after shaving?

    We'd recommend waiting 24 hours after shaving before applying, as freshly shaved skin can be more sensitive.

    Can pregnant or breastfeeding women use it?

    The formula uses natural essential oils in safe concentrations. We always recommend checking with your healthcare provider to be sure.

    Will the scent suit me?

    The pack includes all three - Garden of Eden (floral), Round the Clock (crisp to warm and woody) and Rock N' Roll (zesty citrus). Perfect for figuring out your favourite before committing to one.

    How is this different from a regular deodorant?

    No synthetic chemicals, no plastic packaging, no aluminium, no baking soda. Just plant-based ingredients that work with your body rather than against it.

    How long does one tin last?

    With daily use, each 15g tin lasts approximately 2-3 months with proper care.

    How should I store it?

    Keep it in a cool, dry place and always close the tin after use. Avoid leaving it in direct sunlight or humid spots like the shower shelf.

    What's the shelf life?

    Use within 12 months of manufacture. The date is printed on each tin.

    Can I travel with it?

    Absolutely - solid, compact and spill-proof. No liquids, no leaks, no TSA stress. Perfect for zero-waste travel.

    Does it make a good gift?

    One of our most gifted products. Comes in a beautiful handcrafted pouch with assorted prints - zero-waste and genuinely lovely to receive.

    Can I return the tins?

    Yes! Return empty tins to us through our Return Your Jars programme for discounts on your next order.
